★Request
Display Aston Machan
Costume: Summer tracksuit

Since my mother is a doctor,
Machan's playground was the hospital. In a hospital, life flows.

From upstream to downstream.
Born, flowing along, everything inevitably heads out to sea.

...Is something the matter?
Have you turned to stone?

I honestly told her that since she had disappeared along with the
remains of her "friend" Howa-howa-san, I assumed she was grieving.

...Regardless, there was no doubt she was in shock.
I decided to assist in the search and check outside the academy grounds.

It's all right. I took videos and pictures, after all.
Machan will definitely never forget Mr. Fluffy.
Machan thinks...
Well, the truth is—

It's as natural as needing oxygen to breathe, or not being able
to grasp clouds, or the sun setting in the evening.

But Machan knows. Life is something that flows away.
The hospital taught me that.

Tomorrow, Machan is going to compete in the trials and do wonderfully,
so please come watch.

Looking at her now, however, it clearly meant something else.
What lay there was merely simple, quiet, and poignant...

Mr. Fluffy, since you're white, do you like white flowers best?
Or red? There were yellow ones over there, too.

Aston Machan was calm.
With no trace of tears, she spoke matter-of-factly to the headstone.

...I see.
So Mr. Fluffy went to the sea.
—Suddenly, I remembered Aston Machan's words from the other day.
I was suddenly overcome by an irresistible urge to confirm her true intent.

Uncaring—or perhaps unaware—that I had been struck speechless,
she continued to speak smoothly and calmly.

Because I'm safe and reliable Aston Machan.
He's flying properly in the sky inside me.

What is truly sad is being forgotten.
For me, or for you, to forget Mr. Fluffy.

There are no exceptions. Mr. Fluffy, you... and me, too.
We all must go to the sea.

I should have at least asked what your favorite color was.
Machan made a mistake.

In front of Aston Machan as she stood up,
there was a freshly made mound of earth.
I'm an Umamusume, so I'm more muscular than a human.
That's why I'm not sad.

That is why the most important thing is a trace.
A trace that does not disappear even when gone.
May I say goodbye one last time?

She is a strange girl. Wandering off somewhere is normal for her.
Maybe she went to bury it alone, but still—

...Machan? What happened to that white pigeon...
Wait, that bird...!

She has this aura like she might suddenly drift away somewhere out of reach,
so I guess it just made me anxious...
...Mm. You're the one from before.

Aston Machan was under the overpass
where she had previously slept alongside "Mr. Fluffy."

Over the past few days, I had spoken with Aston Machan on several occasions,
but had she ever given off that kind of vibe?

I see, that's what you mean by "strong."
Indeed, most humans are sad when someone passes away.
Yes.

Ah, you're the one from the other day!
Um, have you seen Machan?
...Machan...?

The pigeon passed away. I didn't know what to do,
and the moment I took my eyes off her, she was gone...
Machan's dream is to become a mascot.

...I had jumped to the conclusion that Aston Machan's desire for merchandise
was merely an extension of wanting attention and love.

*phew*, *pant*, *pant*...
All right, finished the outer lap! Shall we head back to the grounds, Machan?

—After that, the two of us searched for flowers to lay at the grave.
In the end, no answer was put into words.
...There, all done.
